## Import Data using read.csv

```{r}
df_t1 = read.csv("Data/titanic.csv")
```

### Show first 6 rows of data

```{r}
head(df_t1)
```

### Determine how many missing

```{r}
sum(is.na(df_t1))
```

### Check which variables how the missing data

```{r}
colSums(is.na(df_t1))
```

### Structure

```{r}
str(df_t1)
```

### Names or the variable names
```{r}
names(df_t1)
```

### Index into columns
```{r}
mean(df_t1$Age, na.rm=TRUE)
median(df_t1$Age, na.rm=TRUE)
```


### Average Ticket Price
```{r}
mean(df_t1$Ticket)
median(df_t1$Ticket)
```


### Get counts of each category
```{r}
table(df_t1$Sex)
```

### To get proportion of male and female survive
```{r}
sum(df_t1$Sex == "male" & df_t1$Survived == 1) / sum(df_t1$Sex == "male")

sum(df_t1$Sex == "female" & df_t1$Survived == 1) / sum(df_t1$Sex == "female")
```
